feature.caustica.builtin.description: The sky, surfaces, and post effects Caustica ships with.
caustica.screen.title: CAUSTICA
caustica.slot.caustica.sky.tooltip: Which extension draws the sky and everything a ray sees when it leaves the world.
caustica.summary.title: FRAME ORDER
caustica.setting.enabled.tooltip: Replace the raster renderer with the path tracer. Turning this off returns Minecraft to vanilla rendering.
caustica.setting.composite.spp.tooltip: Path-tracing samples taken per pixel each frame. Higher is cleaner but more demanding.
caustica.setting.composite.max-bounces.t: Maximum secondary bounces after the primary hit. Higher captures more indirect light at more cost.
caustica.setting.lights.ris-candidates.t: Candidate lights weighed per shading point for direct lighting from torches, glowstone, and lava. Zero disables it.
caustica.setting.composite.water-waves.t: Animate water-surface normals for moving wave highlights.
caustica.setting.tonemap.gamma.tooltip: Post-transform luminance gamma. Below 1 brightens shadows and midtones while preserving black, white, and colour ratios.
caustica.setting.dlss-rr.enabled.tooltip: Denoise and upscale the traced image with DLSS. Requires supported NVIDIA hardware.
caustica.setting.dlss-rr.quality.tooltip: Lower modes render fewer pixels and upscale harder for framerate; higher modes render more for sharpness.
caustica.setting.frame-generation.enable: Generate intermediate frames with DLSS. Raises framerate without lowering latency.
caustica.setting.frame-generation.multi-: Frames generated per rendered frame. 1 is 2x, 2 is 3x, and so on.
caustica.setting.reflex.enabled.tooltip: Reduce input latency by pacing frame submission. Requires supported NVIDIA hardware.
caustica.setting.exposure.mode.tooltip: Auto adapts to scene luminance; Manual holds the exposure value directly.
caustica.setting.exposure.manual-ev.tool: Exposure in stops. Fixed in Manual; a bias brighter or darker in Auto.
caustica.setting.hdr.enabled.tooltip: Recreate the swapchain for HDR (ST.2084/PQ) output. Requires operating system and display support.
caustica.setting.hdr.ui-nits.tooltip: Absolute brightness, in nits, given to SDR-authored UI on an HDR display.
caustica.setting.hdr.peak-nits.tooltip: Brightness highlights roll off toward. Set this to your display's peak HDR brightness.
caustica.setting.entities.enabled.toolti: Include entities and block entities in the traced scene.
caustica.setting.particles.enabled.toolt: Draw particles as camera-ray billboards inside the traced scene.
caustica.setting.entities.glow.enabled.t: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline, through walls, around glowing entities.
caustica.setting.overlay.block-outline.e: Draw the selection outline around the block you are looking at.
caustica.setting.composite.debug-view.to: Inspect ray-tracing buffers and exposure diagnostics after the normal frame has rendered.
caustica.setting.frame-stats.enabled.too: Log render-frame timings and hitches to the game log.
caustica.setting.screenshots.exr-enabled: Save a scene-linear ACEScg EXR alongside the normal PNG when you take a screenshot.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.bloom.e: Bleed light from bright areas into their surroundings.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.bloom.s: How much of the blurred pyramid is added back over the scene.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.bloom.t: Scene-linear luminance a pixel must exceed before it blooms.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.bloom.s: Softens the threshold so pixels fade into blooming instead of snapping.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.bloom.r: How far light spreads at each pyramid step.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.bloom.l: Pyramid depth. More levels spread light further across the screen.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.sky.sun: How far south of overhead the sun sits at noon, in degrees. Higher gives longer shadows year-round.
Apparent radius of the sun as a light source, in degrees. Larger softens shadow edges.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.sky.moo: Apparent radius of the moon as a light source, in degrees.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.sky.sun: How large the sun sprite is drawn, in degrees. Does not change how much light it casts.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.sky.moo: How large the moon sprite is drawn, in degrees.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.sky.gro: How much light the ground bounces back into the sky. Raising it brightens the whole atmosphere.
caustica.option.caustica.builtin.sky.hor: How far the horizon is blurred, in degrees, to hide the hard edge of the sky model.
caustica.options.rt.exposureMode.tooltip: How the ray-traced image is mapped to display brightness. Auto adapts to scene luminance; Manual uses the exposure value directly.
caustica.options.rt.manualEv.tooltip: Exposure compensation in stops. In Manual, this is the fixed exposure. In Auto, this biases the auto exposure brighter or darker.
caustica.options.rt.gamma.tooltip: Post-transform luminance gamma. Values below 1.00 brighten shadows and midtones while preserving black, white, and color ratios.
caustica.options.rt.spp.tooltip: Path-tracing samples taken per pixel each frame. Higher is cleaner but more demanding.
caustica.options.rt.maxBounces.tooltip: Maximum number of secondary path-tracing bounces after the primary hit. Higher captures more indirect light but costs more.
caustica.options.rt.entities.tooltip: Include entities and block entities in the ray-traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.particles.tooltip: Draw particles as camera-ray billboards inside the traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.glow.tooltip: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline (through walls) around glowing entities.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaves.tooltip: Animate water-surface normals for moving wave highlights.
caustica.options.rt.hdr.tooltip: Recreate the swapchain for HDR (ST.2084/PQ) or native SDR output. Applied at the next frame boundary.
caustica.options.rt.hdrUiBrightness.tool: Absolute brightness (in nits) assigned to SDR-authored UI on an HDR display.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPeak.tooltip: Absolute brightness (in nits) highlights roll off toward. Set to your display's peak HDR brightness.
caustica.options.rt.dlssQuality.tooltip: DLSS Ray Reconstruction quality mode. Lower-quality modes render fewer pixels and upscale more aggressively for higher framerates; higher-quality modes render more pixels for a sharper image. Only affects the image when DLSS Ray Reconstruction is enabled.
caustica.options.rt.debugView.tooltip: Inspect ray-tracing buffers and exposure diagnostics after the normal frame has rendered.
